profile.bio: Hi! I am John Abrahm Zapico, a passionate Computer Science graduate from National University in the Philippines. Coding allows me to create things from scratch and solve problems creatively. Experienced across modern front-end design and back-end database engineering, I build digital experiences that seamlessly bridge aesthetics and functionality.
